about: Wasaga Beach is a town on Georgian Bay in Simcoe County, Ontario, with one of the longest freshwater beaches in the world. It is a major summer tourism destination of beach strips, rental cottages, and a commercial strip behind the dunes, quieter in the off-season as a growing permanent community. The Nottawasaga River meets the bay at the town’s heart. About 25,000 people live in Wasaga Beach.
